event_name: Dodge NHRA Great Lakes Nationals presented by MOPAR

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 59 degrees, relative humidity 75 percent, barometer 30.17 inches,
adjusted altitude 987 feet.

13 of the 14 Top Fuel wins this year have come from the top half of the field.
Shawn Langdon's win in Chicago (#9) is the only Top Fuel win this year from the bottom half of the
field.

Justin Ashley will not be racing today in observance of Yom Kippur 
Billy Torrence is 6-5 in Round 1 when starting ninth (0-2 this year).

torrence starts to lose traction on the top end and clicks it off early.

Tony Stewart has qualified in the top half of the field at 13 of his 15 races this year.
This is Kyle Wurtzel's first race since St. Louis last year.

Stewart is 2 - 0 against Wurtzel in prior events. 

Stewart with the starting line advantage and the power to hold on for the hole shot win in a close
one.  Tony Stewart's MOV: 0.0040 seconds (approximately 23 inches).


Wurtzel with his season quickest pass in the losing effort.

Since his win in Gainesville, Josh Hart has only advanced past the second round twice.
Shawn Reed is 2-11 in Round 1 this year.

Reed is 1 - 0 against Hart in prior events. 

Reed goes red and Hart goes up in smoke, but still get the win.  He will give up lane choice to
Massey in the next round.

Doug Kalitta has won 36 rounds this year. He won 39 rounds during his entire 2025 championship
season.
This is the fourth start for Kyle Satenstein.

This is the first time Kalitta and Satenstein have faced each other in eliminations. 

Satenstein with a great light and then started to mix up cylinders by 330 feet.  The engine lets go
around half tack with a big fireball.

Kalitta launched hard and kept it hooked up to make the second quickest pass of the weekend.  He will
have lane choice over Torrence in the next round.

In his last 11 starts, Tony Schumacher is 2-9 in Round 1.
Spence Massey is 2-0 against Schumacher in Round 1. Their last Round 1 meeting was in Topeka in 2014.

Massey is 15 - 10 against Schumacher in prior events. 

Massey with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.

Schumacher started to lose traction and clicked it off.

Antron Brown has won 20 rounds this year. In his first 14 races last year, he won 16 rounds.
Clay Millican's average E.T. in his last seven losses is 6.233.

Brown is 36 - 9 against Millican in prior events. 

Brown with a great light and makes his career fastest pass for the win.  He will have lane choice
over Stewart in the next round.

Shawn Langdon's 34 round wins are already the fourth-most he has recorded in a single season. He is
the only Top Fuel driver to "sweep" an event this year (MIR).
Maddi Gordon's 17 round wins are the sixth-most in Top Fuel this year.

Gordon is 2 - 1 against Langdon in prior events. 

Gordon with a great light, but starts to shake right at the hit and pedaled it.  she couldn't get it
to hook up and clicked it off.

Langdon launched hard and kept it hooked up and make the quickest pass of the weekend for the win.
He makes the second fastest pass in Top Fuel History.

This is just the second time in his 23 races that Will Smith has qualified in the top half of the
field.
Leah Pruett is 136-96 in Round 1 races.

Pruett is 4 - 0 against Smith in prior events.

Smith with a great light and makes his career quickest and fastest pass for the win.  He will give up
lane choice to langdon in the next round.

Pruett with a great light and good clean pass in the losing effort.
